body.intent: Fix The inbox flags a stalled run against the wrong run, and tells the owner to merge a PR that a live run owns: item 0568a71 (2026-11-08 ~08:00Z) says 'stalled run 01M6VY7E4JWY (the plan run of change set 01M6VY7H9PYX, which succeeded at 2026-11-07) ... the run ended succeeded but its PR is green at f3a3250 and unmerged: merge it by hand'. PR #376 at f3a3250 belongs to ship-change run 01M6WMX236BTT04TYQDACGKBZ4 of the same change set and branch, which was being resumed toward its merge step; a hand merge then breaks that run. The stalled-PR check should match a PR only to the run that opened or pushed it (its ship record), and skip any change set with a live or queued run.
